listeners.why: Restfox's main process tells the window a file workspace changed on disk. This port has no file workspaces and no second process, so it records the callback and never fires it.

noop.why: Setters for state this port does not keep. updateElectronApp: the build updates through Orivon, and Restfox's own updater is Electron's. setDisableSSLVerification: a routed request carries no TLS option, so there is nothing to switch; sendRequest says so when a certificate is refused.

getInstallInfo.why: Main answers which package the app was installed from (snap, deb, portable). This build has no package. 'other' is the value main gives an install it does not recognise; it is read only by the page-view ping, which this port turns off by default (bridge/restfox.js).

openFolderSelectionDialog.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
openFolderSelectionDialog.why: Resolves to a host path string that Restfox then stores as the workspace's location and passes back on every read and write. orivon.fs hands out opaque handles, never paths, and a path-shaped stand-in would reintroduce what that shape prevents (docs/porting-guide.md, the escape test). Reached only from the Choose button of the file workspace forms and from Open File Workspace.

openFolder.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
openFolder.why: Opens a host path in the operating system's file manager, which a page cannot do. Reached only from the file workspace menu, which needs a file workspace to exist.

readFile.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
readFile.why: Reads a path relative to a file workspace's folder for the readFile() a request script calls. Without a file workspace there is no folder to read from. A script that calls it gets this error inside its own sandbox.

getWorkspaceAtLocation.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
getWorkspaceAtLocation.why: Reads a folder's workspace.json from a host path. Part of the file workspace set, which needs the folder picker above.

updateWorkspace.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
updateWorkspace.why: Writes a file workspace's metadata to its folder. Restfox calls it only for a workspace of type file, and none can be created here.

ensureEmptyFolderOrEmptyWorkspace.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
ensureEmptyFolderOrEmptyWorkspace.why: Checks a chosen folder before a file workspace is created in it.

getCollectionForWorkspace.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
getCollectionForWorkspace.why: Restfox's db.ts calls it only when the workspace's _type is file; every other workspace lives in IndexedDB, which the page owns.

getCollectionById.detail: file workspaces are not built in this port
getCollectionById.why: Same gate as getCollectionForWorkspace: file workspaces only.
